tileLegend.name: No Entry Zone
tileLegend.description: Can't deploy melee unit on it. Impassable

tileLegend.name: Mire
tileLegend.description: Gradually reduces the ASPD of Operators within, and the ASPD and Movement Speed of enemies within

tileLegend.name: High Ground
tileLegend.description: Can deploy ranged unit on it. Impassable

tileLegend.name: Non-deployable Area
tileLegend.description: Can't deploy melee unit on it. Passable

tileLegend.description: Enemies will enter the battlefield from here.

tileLegend.name: Protection Objective
tileLegend.description: Blue objective point. Its HP decreases when an enemy unit enters it.

tileLegend.name: Fence
tileLegend.description: Can deploy melee units on it. Enemies cannot enter
